title: ci: add per-prompt regression metrics hook & integration tests
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: onboarding continuous per-prompt regression metrics in PRs so we can automatically detect quality regressions early and tie them to prompt-sets. This PR introduces a CI hook that runs the eval-harness against a small canonical prompt-set (per-targeted model) and emits per-prompt precision/recall/F1/ROUGE-like metrics to the eval-metrics service and GitHub Checks API. If any prompt crosses configured regression thresholds the check is marked as failed and a summary is posted to the PR. What this change does: adds a new lightweight pytest-based integration that runs selected prompts (sample size small to keep runtime ~3-7 minutes), computes per-prompt and aggregated metrics, and uploads results to the existing eval-metrics ingestion endpoint. The CI hook is plumbed into the repo-level GitHub Actions workflow (eval-ci.yaml) and gated behind the label `run-eval-ci` for non-blocking rollout. Files changed: git hub workflow, a new runner script (scripts/eval_ci/run_prompt_metrics.py), a metrics adapter (eval_harness/ci/metrics_hook.py), tests (tests/integration/test_prompt_metrics_ci.py), and docs (docs/ci/eval-metrics-hook.md). Checklist: - [x] Hook implementation and adapter - [x] Small canonical prompt-sets for english-chat & embeddings smoke tests - [x] Unit + integration tests + fixtures - [x] GitHub Actions workflow update with matrix for models - [x] Documentation and release notes Testing notes: local run via `python -m scripts.eval_ci.run_prompt_metrics --sample 10 --dry-run` will print computed metrics and validate the payload schema. CI runs include a non-blocking baseline run and a gated run when `run-eval-ci` label is present. Regression thresholds are configured in `.github/eval_ci/thresholds.yaml` and are tunable per-model. Rollout plan: Deploy as opt-in first (label), monitor false positives for 2 weeks, then enable as a default required check for the `redwood` repo for PRs that touch `eval_harness` or `models/` directories. Related Linear: ENG-8421. Notes on performance: reduced prompt sample sizes by default to keep runtime reasonable; the hook supports caching/resume to avoid re-running expensive model downloads on long-lived runners.
